subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 13, 2026
body:
**EuroPython 2026 Videos Published**

The EuroPython 2026 conference, held in Kraków, Poland from July 13 to 17, has released its videos online. The conference featured a wide range of talks and presentations on various topics related to Python and its ecosystem. The videos are now available on the EuroPython website, providing a valuable resource for those who missed the conference or want to revisit the talks.

**Community News**

The AcreetionOS community has been actively contributing to various open-source projects. Our developers have been busy working on updates, bug fixes, and new features for the distribution. We're proud to see our community members participating in conferences like EuroPython and sharing their knowledge with the world.

**Practical Tip**

Did you know that you can easily update your AcreetionOS system using the `sudo pacman -Syu` command in the terminal? This command will update all installed packages to their latest versions, ensuring your system stays up-to-date and secure. Simply open a terminal and run the command to get started!

Stay tuned for more updates from the AcreetionOS community!
